newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end strong on technical rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end strong on technical rally.

text.p: Nov 20 - U.S. debt futures powered to a strong finish shortly before the close of pit trading on Wednesday. Dec T-bonds set a new nine-month high of 115-25/32, eclipsing last Friday's nine-month high of 115-15/32. Traders called topping last Friday's high a strong technical support. They said results from the U.S. Treasury 5-year notes auction were good. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
